Method.name: GetParameter
execProc
Method.Implementation: $$$TRACE("Brent -- Enter execProc.") Set pHasResultSet=..%JGProxy.execute(pHS) Set:""=pHasResultSet pHasResultSet=-1 If -1=pHasResultSet { Set ..sqlcode=-400, pHasResultSet=0, tTxt=..%JGProxy.getErrorText(), tTxt="JDBC Gateway SP execute("_pHS_") error "_pHasResultSet_$S(""=tTxt||($C(0)=tTxt):"",1:": "_tTxt) Quit $$$ERROR($$$RemoteGatewayError,tTxt) } Kill ..%rowcount(pHS) While 'pHasResultSet { $$$TRACE("Brent -- Enter While 'pHasResultSet") Set tUpdCount=..%JGProxy.getUpdateCount(pHS) Set:""=tUpdCount tUpdCount=-1 $$$TRACE("Brent -- tUpdCount="_tUpdCount) Quit:-1=tUpdCount ; proceed if no more Update Counts, otherwise save Update Count and try again Do addrowcount(pHS,tUpdCount) Set pHasResultSet=..%JGProxy.getMoreResults(pHS) Set:""=pHasResultSet pHasResultSet=-1 ; proceed if there are Results (or error); otherwise try for another Update Count $$$TRACE("pHasResultSet="_pHasResultSet) } If 'pHasResultSet||((-1'=pHasResultSet)&&(-1'=..%JGProxy.getResultSet(pHS))) Set ..sqlcode=0 Set:pHasResultSet ..%rowcount(pHS)=0 Quit $$$OK ; start count for ResultSet if needed Set ..sqlcode=-400, tTxt=..%JGProxy.getErrorText(), tTxt="JDBC Gateway SP execute "_$S(-1=pHasResultSet:"getMoreResults",1:"getResultSet")_"("_pHS_") error"_$S(""=tTxt||($C(0)=tTxt):"",1:": "_tTxt), pHasResultSet=0 Quit $$$ERROR($$$RemoteGatewayError,tTxt) addrowcount(hs,c) $$$TRACE("Brent -- Enter addrowcount") If '$D(..%rowcount(hs)) { Set ..%rowcount(hs)=c } Else { Set tI=1+$O(..%rowcount(hs,""),-1) Set:tI=1 tI=2 Set ..%rowcount(hs,tI)=c } $$$TRACE("Brent -- Exit addrowcount")
